_comment: Mobile test sharding for @qvac/tts-ggml, keyed by platform then by the matrix engine. The mobile workflow (integration-mobile-test-tts-ggml.yml) resolves ONE group per build row via its 'Resolve functional test-groups by engine' step: the row's matrix.engine picks the list here (any non-cosyvoice engine uses the 'chatterbox' catch-all group; the 'cosyvoice' row runs only cosyvoice). This keeps CosyVoice3 — whose ~2.4 GB model directory is adb-pre-staged only on the dedicated cosyvoice row and is too large to fetch reliably on-device elsewhere — off the chatterbox row, while the chatterbox row keeps full Chatterbox/Supertonic/Parler/LavaSR coverage (their smaller GGUFs fetch on-device). The perf benchmarks (runRtfBenchmarkTest, runStreamingBenchmarkTest) are intentionally NOT listed: they live in perf-tests.json and a benchmark run (run_rtf_benchmarks=true) builds its test-groups from that file instead. Only the 'ios' and 'android' keys are consumed; this _comment is ignored.
